So sheet 97's hundred-blocks run 22xx-24xx and sheet 90's run 26xx-28xx: the 25xx block, between Ave S (sheet 97's east limit) and Ave S 1/2 (sheet 90's west limit), is on neither plate, and no avenue crosses both. The margin references agree that the two plates are not vertically adjacent: sheet 90's south margin prints '98', not 97, and sheet 97's north margin prints '89', not 90 - the rows are offset in x, so 90 and 97 are diagonal neighbours meeting at most at a corner. The detector's near-seam candidates are in any case both mid-block: sheet 90 x=1764 sits inside the 2700 block between the 2714 and 2716 frontages, and sheet 97 x=1735 sits inside the 2300 block just east of its dashed 20-ft alley (native 1607.8-1666.6).
